slice: D5 - small tools, storage, organisation, travel gear, hardware-free gadgets

ideas.name: Reveal-Fit Window Shelf
ideas.concept: Tension-fit, no-drill powder-coated steel shelf that wedges into deep Nordic window reveals for plants, books and daylight styling.
ideas.target_customer: Young renters and solo urban dwellers in micro-flats in SE/DK.
ideas.problem_solved: No wall space and no permission to drill; windows are the only free surface.
ideas.trend_evidence: Eurostat shows single-adult households up 16.9% 2015-2024 vs 5.8% for all households; Bofrid and AAU describe growing micro-apartment interest in Sweden and Denmark. I found no data on window-shelf sales, so product demand is inferred, not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Reveal-depth sizing system and tension mechanism (design registration), VELUX-style window knowledge, modular add-on trays.
ideas.tooling_needed: Laser-cut and bent sheet steel, no moulds; fixtures under EUR 500

ideas.name: Radiator Glove and Boot Dryer Shelf
ideas.concept: Heat-safe stainless shelf that hooks over panel radiators to dry gloves, hats and insoles in small flats without a drying room.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic renters, new parents and dog walkers in small apartments.
ideas.problem_solved: Wet winter gear and no mudroom or drying space.
ideas.trend_evidence: Same small-flat and solo-living evidence (Sweden over 50% one-person households per Eurostat 2017, micro-flat trend per Bofrid). No direct search-volume data was verified for this product.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Fit-to-Nordic-radiator-profile design and thermal safety testing as barrier; indoor-climate credibility from building background.
ideas.tooling_needed: Bent stainless wire/sheet, simple press tooling under EUR 800; check heat/GPSR testing

ideas.name: Roof-Window Reach Pole
ideas.concept: Telescopic, design-grade hook pole for opening and closing high or roof windows and blinds, with a soft-tip and storage clip.
ideas.target_customer: Older adults staying at home and attic/loft dwellers; gift buyers for parents.
ideas.problem_solved: Hard-to-reach window handles and blind cords without ladders; non-medical convenience.
ideas.trend_evidence: Aging-in-place consumer products market reports cite easy-reach and accessible daily-living tools and a shift to e-commerce (vendor-sponsored, directional only). No sizing for reach poles was found.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Compatibility with VELUX-type handle and cord geometries, fit guide and bundled blind-cord adaptors; domain credibility.
ideas.tooling_needed: Off-the-shelf aluminium telescopic tube with custom head via CNC or 3D print; minimal tooling

ideas.name: Wall-Mount Lever Jar and Bottle Opener
ideas.concept: Under-cabinet adhesive/screw-mount stamped steel lever opener designed as a good-looking, non-medical-looking helper for weak grip.
ideas.target_customer: Adults 60+ and their adult children buying gifts; arthritic but non-clinical users.
ideas.problem_solved: Hard-to-open jars and bottles, without a medical-looking aid.
ideas.trend_evidence: Aging-in-place report notes a coverage gap between consumer furniture and regulated medical equipment, and easy-grip tools sold increasingly via e-commerce; no specific jar-opener sizing found. Must avoid medical claims.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design-led premium aesthetic and brand positioning versus clinical competitors; ergonomic profile design registration.
ideas.tooling_needed: Stamped steel progressive die about EUR 800-1.5k or laser-cut plus bend; avoid injection moulds

ideas.name: Dog Hotel-Stay Roll
ideas.concept: Fold-flat waterproof roll holding a mat, collapsible bowl and towel for pet-friendly travel and hotel stays.
ideas.target_customer: Pet owners treating dogs as family who travel with them in the Nordics.
ideas.problem_solved: Keeping hotel and rental rooms clean while travelling with a dog, in one packable organiser.
ideas.trend_evidence: Euromonitor identifies humanisation as a key driver of pet product sales; a market report (Fortune/GII listing) projects pet travel accessories growing around 6.45% CAGR. Search found Swedish and Danish new dog registrations falling, so volume tailwind is not confirmed; premium positioning only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Nordic design language and bundle; weak copy resistance, so brand and community must carry it.
ideas.tooling_needed: Cut-and-sew with TPU-laminated fabric, no hard tooling
